description_en: Queries a list of versions for a ranking model
kebab_example: aliyun airec list-ranking-model-versions --instance-id airec-cn-0000 --template-id 1 --page 1 --size 10 --status TRAINING --api-version 2020-11-26 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRankingModelVersions

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页展示条数，默认为10，限制:[1-50]
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The state of the version. Valid values: DRAFT: The version is in the draft state. EFFECTIVE: The version is effective. PUBLISHING: The version is being published. INEFFECTIVE: The version has expired. FAILED: The version has not taken effect
parameters.help_zh:
版本状态。

取值：

DRAFT：草稿状态。

EFFECTIVE：生效状态。

PUBLISHING：发布中状态。

INEFFECTIVE：已失效状态。

FAILED：未生效状态
parameters.name: status
